crime_highlights: Douglas fired the weapon five times in the apartment
Douglas shot Blackmon three times, Belcourt once, and White once
Blackmon and Belcourt died as a result of their injuries
Belcourt was shot in the head and died instantly
White was shot through her neck and shoulder
rationale_highlights: Douglas has suffered from several adverse factors that affect Aboriginals in general
I accept that all of these factors are present.
in the circumstances of this case Douglas's moral culpability is reduced as a result of Gladue factors
his background was a major contributing factor

crime_highlights: Ms. Taniskishayinew stabbed Mr. Boucher a single time in the torso with a kitchen butcher knife
She then walked away and left him on the street
rationale_highlights: Ms. Taniskishayinew's history has been greatly influenced by what our society has done to the Indigenous communities through the degradations and deprivations imposed by colonization and the residential school system
She had less opportunity than did the offender in Johnson to overcome the legacy of residential schools.
Given her painful and harsh life, it is little wonder that Ms. Taniskishayinew reacts violently and impulsively and drowns her emotional pain with intoxicants.
It does not seem right, as a society, that we do not have better options for her than jail.
note: Effect on sentence is implicit rather than an explicit reduction statement.

crime_highlights: the complainant and her mother moved in with the applicant when she was 16 years of age and the applicant was approximately 67 years of age
During these trips, the complainant was 100% dependent upon the accused for all of her needs.
The applicant engaged in a sexual relationship with the complainant over a period of approximately 18 months until she left in 2011.
rationale_highlights: His First Nations status has to be considered in light of the Gladue factors.
a number of adverse factors that affect aboriginal people in general are present in the applicant's personal life
Overt racism in the home by adopted father
note: Court never states Gladue factors reduced the sentence; mandatory minimum upheld.
